tweaks.title: Turn Off Inking and Typing Personalization
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from collecting what you type and write to build a personal dictionary for handwriting and text suggestions.
tweaks.impactNote: Privacy setting. No measurable effect on FPS or latency.
tweaks.recommendReason: A desktop gaming PC with no pen gains nothing from typing and ink collection. Both values are already 1 on this PC, so applying it should report no change.
tweaks.sideEffects: Handwriting and typing suggestions stop learning new words from you.

tweaks.title: Turn Off Online Speech Recognition
tweaks.description: Keeps dictation and voice input from sending your speech to Microsoft's cloud speech service.
tweaks.impactNote: Privacy setting. No measurable effect on FPS or latency.
tweaks.recommendReason: Matches Settings > Privacy > Speech > Online speech recognition: Off. HasAccepted is already 0 on this PC, so this mainly keeps it that way.
tweaks.sideEffects: Cloud dictation (Win+H) stops working. Offline speech features are unaffected.

tweaks.title: Block Apps From Reading Diagnostic Info
tweaks.description: Store apps can no longer read diagnostic information about other running apps, such as which apps are open.
tweaks.impactNote: Privacy setting. No measurable effect on FPS or latency.
tweaks.recommendReason: Uses the documented App Privacy policy (Force Deny). Nothing on a typical gaming setup needs Store apps to see other apps.
tweaks.sideEffects: Store apps that list or manage other apps can no longer see them. Desktop programs are not affected.

tweaks.title: Turn Off Voice Activation for Apps
tweaks.description: Stops apps from listening for a wake word, both while you are signed in and on the lock screen.
tweaks.impactNote: Privacy setting. No measurable effect on FPS or latency.
tweaks.recommendReason: Cortana is not used on this PC, so no app needs to listen for a wake word.
tweaks.sideEffects: Voice assistants can't be started by saying their wake word. Starting them by click or keyboard still works.

tweaks.title: Turn Off Settings Sync
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from syncing your theme, language and other settings to your Microsoft account.
tweaks.impactNote: Removes a small amount of background sync traffic. No measurable effect on FPS.
tweaks.recommendReason: Only useful if you don't want settings shared across PCs. Not pre-selected because some people rely on sync.
tweaks.sideEffects: Theme, language preferences and other synced settings no longer roam to your other Windows PCs. Users can't turn sync back on in Settings while this policy is set.

tweaks.title: Stop Offline Maps Background Downloads
tweaks.description: Turns off automatic downloading and updating of offline map data, and the unrequested network traffic from the Offline Maps settings page.
tweaks.impactNote: Removes occasional background downloads. No measurable effect on FPS.
tweaks.recommendReason: Pairs with the Maps service tweak. A gaming PC rarely needs offline maps.
tweaks.sideEffects: Downloaded offline maps stop updating automatically. You can still update them by hand in Settings.

tweaks.title: Stop Tracking App Launches
tweaks.description: Windows stops recording which apps you open to personalise Start and search results.
tweaks.impactNote: Privacy setting. No measurable effect on FPS or latency.
tweaks.recommendReason: Matches Settings > Privacy > General > Let Windows track app launches: Off. It is currently on (Start_TrackProgs = 1).
tweaks.sideEffects: The Most used list in Start stops updating, and the Run dialog (Win+R) stops remembering commands you type.

tweaks.title: Stop Device Info Downloads
tweaks.description: Windows stops fetching device icons and descriptions from the internet for hardware you plug in.
tweaks.impactNote: Privacy setting. No measurable effect on FPS or latency.
tweaks.recommendReason: Harmless, but the benefit is small, so it is not pre-selected.
tweaks.sideEffects: Devices and Printers may show generic icons and fewer details for new hardware. Driver installation is not affected.

tweaks.title: Stop Online Font Downloads
tweaks.description: Windows stops downloading fonts on demand from Microsoft's font service. Fonts already installed keep working.
tweaks.impactNote: Privacy setting. No measurable effect on FPS or latency.
tweaks.recommendReason: Small privacy gain. Not pre-selected because text in less common scripts may fall back to a different font.
tweaks.sideEffects: Apps that ask Windows for a font you don't have installed get a fallback font instead of a download.

tweaks.title: Turn Off Windows Ink Workspace
tweaks.description: Removes the pen workspace and its suggested-app tiles. A desktop with no pen never uses it.
tweaks.impactNote: Removes an unused feature. No measurable effect on FPS.
tweaks.recommendReason: This PC has no pen or touch screen, so nothing is lost. Not pre-selected because the gain is cosmetic.
tweaks.sideEffects: The Windows Ink Workspace button and Sketchpad shortcuts disappear.

tweaks.title: Clear Sign-In Background
tweaks.description: Shows the sign-in screen background without the frosted blur effect.
tweaks.impactNote: Purely cosmetic. The blur only runs on the sign-in screen, never in games.
tweaks.recommendReason: Matter of taste. Included because it is a documented policy, not because it speeds anything up.
tweaks.sideEffects: The sign-in screen looks sharper but less stylised.

tweaks.title: Turn Off Reserved Storage
tweaks.description: Frees the space (about 7 GB) Windows keeps aside so updates always have room to install.
tweaks.impactNote: Frees disk space only. No effect on FPS.
tweaks.recommendReason: The 1 TB MX500 has plenty of room, so the reserve is rarely needed, but it is not pre-selected because it protects updates on a full drive.
tweaks.sideEffects: If the drive fills up, Windows updates can fail to install. The change is refused while an update is in progress; try again after it finishes.
